title: "Research"

My research focuses on environmental and resource economics, development economics, and the economics of climate change, with an emphasis on impacts, adaptation, and ecosystem services.

## Additional Report Contributions

**Recognition of the Global Green Growth Index:** The Index received the Innovative Impact Award at the AI for Good Global Summit in Geneva on July 7, 2026. I am a member of the International Expert Group for the Global Green Growth Index and have contributed to the Index reports listed below. [Read GGGI's announcement](https://gggi.org/global-green-growth-index-receives-ai-for-good-innovative-impact-award/).

Contributions to the Global Green Growth Institute's *Green Growth Index*: 2019 (*Concepts, Methods and Applications*), 2021 and 2022 (*Measuring performance in achieving SDG targets*), and the 2025 summary report (*Measuring green growth performance, potential, and pathways*). See the [GGGI publications catalogue](https://greengrowthindex.gggi.org/publications-2/) and [CV](cv.html) for details.
